title: qevc: Quantum Event Validity Certification — conditional validity of (quantum) event classifiers under collider systematics and estimation uncertainty
description:
Exact 0.3.1 / npjqi-submission-v1.1 patch release of the qevc research code and submission artifacts for Conditional validity of quantum event classifiers under collider systematics and quantum estimation uncertainty.

This version adds the bounded post-hoc PSD robustness analysis prompted by the final technical audit. All 30 frozen E16 finite-shot deployments were deterministically replayed; every historical primary summary matched. Minimum diagonal loading preserved the zero far-margin deployment-relative flip rate but changed several ideal-anchored magnitudes, yielding the declared verdict PSD-SENSITIVE-BUT-SCOPED. The historical RAW-INDEFINITE pipeline remains primary.

The archive contains the 26-page manuscript, 12-page Supplementary Information, one-page cover letter, self-contained submission/source ZIP, the complete derived E16 PSD JSON, checksums and release documentation. No new experiment, Gram realization, seed, sample, dataset, model, feature map, hyperparameter, claim, QPU job or E20 execution was added. The eight-qubit study is classically simulable, the IBM evidence is micro-scale, and no quantum advantage is claimed.
